It does NOT apply to international-student admission tracks (OzU's own equivalency exam, YÖS-based, or foreign-diploma routes), which each institution runs on its own separate calendar; several of those are recorded as their own rows in this batch (e.g. Gebze's 2026 international timeline). deadline_text_verbatim: Second ranking list: Published on the University noticeboard starting at 10:30 AM on September 7, 2026. Registration by 11:59:59 PM on September 9, 2026.
limitations: Scoped to Engineering Bachelor programmes' second-ranking-list registration window specifically — the call runs multiple earlier phases (early enrolment, first phase, standard enrolment) with their own earlier deadlines that were not individually extracted in this pass, and non-Engineering bachelor's programmes run separate calls entirely.

deadline_text_verbatim: Applicants' Online Applications: Start Date March 9, 2026, End Date July 3, 2026. (Earlier placement rounds close sooner: Early Admission covers applications submitted 9 March - 3 April 2026; 1st Placement 9 March - 30 April 2026; 2nd Placement 9 March - 29 May 2026; 3rd Placement 9 March - 3 July 2026. A Second Application Period, 3-14 August 2026, runs only if quotas remain vacant.)
limitations: GTU runs rolling placement rounds rather than one single cutoff; this row records the final (3rd Placement) online-application close date, the latest point by which an application must be in for the standard 2026 cycle. Applying earlier reaches an earlier, less-competitive placement round — recording only the final date understates that real advantage of applying early, which this university's own page emphasizes.
